title: toast at most one action
name: Toast at most one action
rule: At most one action — a static white, secondary, outline button; concise; only when the action is directly related to the toast text.
pass_when: Zero or one related concise action, styled as that secondary outline control.
fail_when: Two or more toast actions, or an unrelated action on the toast.
overview: A toast may carry at most one related concise secondary outline action.
apply_when: Adding an optional action on a confirmation or status toast.
not_when: Multi-step recovery flows or unrelated actions that belong in the page.
agent_hint: Limit toast actions to zero or one related concise secondary outline button.
description: Spectrum toasts allow at most one action: a static white secondary outline button, concise, and only when it relates directly to the toast text. Two or more actions, or an unrelated control on the toast, overloads a low-priority surface. Prefer zero or one related action; move broader recovery or navigation into the page or a dialog.
do_not_claim: Polar modal max two bottom actions as this toast row.
